text: おまえ　どうせ　バッジ　もってねーだろ？

structure.jp: バッジ　もってねーだろ？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て plus いる after a verb says a state is going on now; here it is shortened and turned into 'not', and ねー is a rough way to say ない. もってねー = 'don't have'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end says 'I bet' or 'right?'; だろ is the short rough form. もってねーだろ = 'you don't have any, do you'.
